note: 仅导出归属本人的已审阅字段；运行队列、凭据及其他用户资料不纳入导出。

datasets.name: profile
datasets.select: SELECT id,username,cell_phone,type,status,create_time FROM `user` WHERE id=? ORDER BY id
datasets.eligible: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user WHERE id=? AND status=0 AND update_time<?
datasets.cleanup: UPDATE user SET username=CONCAT('deleted_',id),cell_phone=CONCAT('x',LPAD(HEX(id),16,'0')) WHERE id=? AND status=0 AND update_time<?

datasets.name: details
datasets.select: SELECT id,name,gender,email,qq,birthday,job,province,city,district,intro FROM user_detail WHERE id=? ORDER BY id
datasets.count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_detail WHERE id=?
datasets.eligible: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_detail WHERE id=? AND update_time<?
datasets.cleanup: UPDATE user_detail SET name='已注销学员',email=NULL,qq=NULL,birthday=NULL,job=NULL,province=NULL,city=NULL,district=NULL,intro=NULL,icon=NULL,photo=NULL WHERE id=? AND update_time<?

datasets.name: consents
datasets.select: SELECT policy_version,accepted_at FROM user_privacy_consent WHERE user_id=? ORDER BY accepted_at,policy_version
datasets.count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_privacy_consent WHERE user_id=?

datasets.name: operations
datasets.select: SELECT operation_id,kind,status,error_code,created_at,updated_at FROM reliability_operation WHERE user_id=? ORDER BY created_at,operation_id
datasets.count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reliability_operation WHERE user_id=?
